neighbours.label: Pieces of romanised Japanese names: 'ira' in Akira, ' Tak…' (Takeshi, Takeda, Takahashi), 'ora' in Tora; other Japanese names and non-Japanese names stay quiet
fire: The anime Akira was released in Japanese cinemas in 1988.
